system.description: When you succeed on a defense roll against an attack that would have dealt you an especially powerful blow or effect as determined by your GM, you regain 4 points to your Might Pool. Each use of this ability after the first time restores 1 fewer Pool point; this renews after you take a ten-hour recovery. Enabler.
